```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
# them but doesn't run them again.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(engine = function(options) {
  if (options$engine == "bash") options$eval <- FALSE
  options
})
```

Notes for [Workshop 2](https://mb5370.bioinformatics.guide/workshop2.html). Run the commands for this workshop in the Terminal, from inside the folder named under each heading. Copy each command you run into a bash chunk.

## Redbean assembly

Commands run in `redbean/`.

Running redbean in the redbean folder:

```{bash}
cd ~/mb5370-workshops/redbean
```

Collect a small subset of data for the initial assembly.

```{bash}
cat /pvol/data/amtp4/*_[012].fastq > amtp4.fastq
```

Run the assembly (took around \~40 seconds.)

```{bash}
wtdbg2 -x ont -g 5m -t 4 -i amtp4.fastq -fo amtp4
wtpoa-cns -t 4 -i amtp4.ctg.lay.gz -fo amtp4.ctg.fa
```

Inspect assembly statistics

```{bash}
assembly-stats amtp4.ctg.fa
```

The assembly is somewhat contiguous, but likely not nearly complete.

**Table 1:** Assembly statistics output

| STATISTIC | RESULT | MEANING |
|----------------------------|-----------------------|---------------------|
| Total assembly length | 3,816,933 bp | All contigs together contain \~3.82 Mb of sequence |
| Number of contigs | 129 | The assembly is split into 129 separate pieces |
| Average contig length | 29,589 bp | Mean contig size is \~29.6 kb |
| Largest contig | 159,611 bp | The longest continuous assembled sequence is \~160 kb |
| N50 | 48,075 bp | 50% of the assembly is contained in contigs ≥48,075 bp |
| N90 | 13,023 bp | 90% is contained in contigs ≥13,023 bp |
| Ns | 0 | No ambiguous `N` bases |
| Gaps | 0 | No gaps represented in the assembly |
| Total assembly length | 3,816,933 bp | All contigs together contain \~3.82 Mb of sequence |

Run redbean with higher coverage: redo the assembly using a better coverage depth (\~20x coverage). This took around \~153.263 sec.

```{bash}
cat /pvol/data/amtp4/*.fastq > amtp4_20x.fastq
wtdbg2 -x ont -g 5m -t 4 -i amtp4_20x.fastq -fo amtp4_20x
wtpoa-cns -t 4 -i amtp4_20x.ctg.lay.gz -fo amtp4_20x.ctg.fa
```

Inspect assembly statistics

```{bash}
assembly-stats amtp4_20x.ctg.fa
```

**Table 2**: Output from assembly statistics

| STATISTIC | RESULT | MEANING |
|------------------------|----------------|---------------------------------|
| **Total assembly length** | **7,072,581 bp** | All contigs together contain \~7.07 Mb of sequence |
| **Number of contigs** | **92** | The assembly is split into 92 separate pieces |
| **Average contig length** | **76,876 bp** | Mean contig size is \~76.9 kb |
| **Largest contig** | **3,344,015 bp** | The longest continuous assembled sequence is \~3.34 Mb |
| **N50** | **1,764,942 bp** | 50% of the assembly is contained in contigs ≥1,764,942 bp |
| **N90** | **27,112 bp** | 90% of the assembly is contained in contigs ≥27,112 bp |
| **Ns** | **0** | No ambiguous `N` bases |
| **Gaps** | **0** | No gaps represented in the assembly |
| **Total assembly length** | **7,072,581 bp** | All contigs together contain \~7.07 Mb of sequence |

This assembly is more contiguous.
